name: Editorial
description: Paper, a serif, and a quiet rule, like a magazine page.
bestFor: Essays, docs, and long reads where type should lead.

tokens.font: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

promptFragment: Visual style: Editorial. Use warm paper, a serif for titles and body, black ink, a hairline rule, and one burgundy action color. Corners are square and shadows are absent. Align to a strict column and leave real margins. Avoid neon, clay shadows, and decorative patterns behind the text. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
